assumptions: Final fixtures, power, rigging, exposure, and color values will be confirmed by qualified crew at prelight.
lighting_philosophy: Let one motivated practical establish control, then allow a new story source to change the relationship.

setups.environment_time_basis: Interior work area at scripted night; the built-in work light is the only confirmed environmental source.
setups.motivation: A built-in work light makes the subject's first action legible.
sources: controlled off-screen extension of the practical
setups.direction: Top-side across the subject while preserving the established screen geography.
setups.quality: Controlled soft key with a narrow harder edge on the important surface detail.
setups.color_intent: Restrained cool-neutral light distinct from the later story source.
setups.exposure_contrast: Retain important face and highlight detail while keeping background geometry separated in shadow.
control: Flag spill from the reflective background
Record the approved level and modifier positions
continuity: Match practical state, shadow direction, and reflective-surface treatment
safety: Qualified crew approve power, rigging, heat, access, and performer clearance
setups.dramatic_purpose: Make the first voluntary action the first stable visual change.
